fields.headline: Design-system glossary
fields.summary: The words this documentation uses in a specific sense, so a sentence means the same thing on every page. Four of them below.

media.alt: Abstract illustration of layered UI panels

terms.name: Design token
terms.description: A named value — a colour, a spacing step, a duration — stored once and referenced everywhere, so a change lands in one place instead of two hundred.

terms.name: Container query
terms.description: A style rule that reacts to the width of an element's own container rather than the viewport, which is what lets one card work as a hero and as a sidebar item.

terms.name: Cascade layer
terms.description: An explicit priority band in the cascade. Rules in a later layer beat earlier ones regardless of specificity, which removes most reasons to write !important.

terms.name: Light DOM component
terms.description: A custom element that keeps its children in the ordinary document tree instead of a shadow root, so page CSS, form submission and search engines all still see them.
